profile.headline: Software Engineer - Graphics at BigBox VR

positions.title: Software Engineer - Graphics
positions.description:
-Worked on shader batching system for UI Elements

-Implemented varying shader effects for the UI including Bokeh Blur and Masking

-GPU Optimizations for drawing UI elements

positions.title: Software Engineer - Graphics
positions.description:
-Implemented multiple PBR material shaders, including hair lighting

-Helped with optimization for existing PBR shaders targeting performance on mobile devices 

-Developed system to allow for shader uniform data to be programmatically exposed to our proprietary studio environment to allow easier adjusting of shaders for artists 

-Implemented state cache machine in OpenGL-based graphics engine to help improve performance on mobile devices

-Added further UI elements to in-house graphics studio to expose physics and material properties on objects

-Worked with art team in creating demo scenes to showcase material shaders

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
-Facilitated company-wide adoption of Coupa, a new procurement software

-Worked with tech, studio, and facilities teams throughout the company to identify efficient and effective procurement users

-Weekly data analysis and reports of company spending including trends and forecasts

-Led trainings for new procurement users and supported procurement needs in offices and facility centers across the country

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
-  Managed the creation, documentation, and execution of new projects.

-  Trained clients and oversaw their use of the Document Automation Tool.  DAT is a 
proprietary web based application to allow clients to build custom documents to be 
printed in RR Donnelley’s facilities and then shipped to the client’s customers.

-  Managed databases of our client’s customer’s data to be dynamically inserted when printing.

-  Implemented variable logic and HTML edits to client’s documents within the Document Automation Tool.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description: As part of a team of three interns, I developed and shipped Apple iOS and Android versions of the Emergency Reporting software used by thousands of Fire Departments and Emergency Responders around the world.  I was solely responsible for the initial release of the iOS application, and continue to develop ongoing enhancements.  As part of my responsibilities there I worked with web services, SQLite design and implementation, encryption to meet Department of Defense standards, and learned agile development methods.  After starting as an intern I was then hired on full-time.
